name: Lagos Flood Aug 2025
cause_prelim: ~13 h of overnight rain (19:30 3 Aug → ~08:30 4 Aug) on dry ground (7–13 mm prior week); AOI mean peak 7.9 mm/h at 01:30, cells to 31 mm/h; 120–160 mm over Lekki/Lagos Island/Ikorodu. The 01:30 peak coincided with a weak high tide (0.10 m) — little tidal contribution. Duration matches Wahab's '12 hours' (IMERG + EOT20)
cause_plain: About 13 hours of overnight rain from 19:30 3 Aug on dry ground (7–13 mm the week before), 120–160 mm over Lekki, Lagos Island and Ikorodu. A weak high tide (0.10 m) at the 01:30 peak added little.
open_questions: ClimaMeter's 191 deaths is unverified against Nigerian reporting — not used
Only Sentinel-1 pass (S1A, 3 Aug 06:30) is ~13 h before the rain — usable only as a dry 'before' image
Ijede/Ikorodu flooding may involve lagoon backwater from the Lagos Lagoon's north shore — not modelled
Media evidence: 16 of 22 quotes unverifiable (Guardian NG / Channels TV block automated checks)
open_questions_plain: A figure of 191 deaths is unverified against Nigerian reporting and is not used.
The only radar satellite pass (3 Aug 06:30) is about 13 hours before the rain, so it is usable only as a dry 'before' image.
Ijede/Ikorodu flooding may involve lagoon backwater from the Lagos Lagoon's north shore — this is not modelled.
News reports: 16 of 22 quotes unverifiable (Guardian NG / Channels TV block automated checks).
